audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Level 1, Levels 4-5, Level 6 and 2+ items to 'Skill'/'Tryndamere' in a pattern that contradicts the packet level chart and the already-audited mirror, which has Tryndamere ahead through First item and Vladimir ahead at 2+ items. phases[6].why also claims your pattern is at full power while the row was credited to Tryndamere.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Tryndamere rows 0-5, Vladimir row 6. The prose (whys[0], whys[6], late) already tells that story; only the row tokens disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 to Tryndamere in both full and content layers, row 6 to Vladimir, with row 6 rating raised to 7/10 to match the scaling flip.

audit.why: Spikes were already keyed correctly: his Fury/crit-item first-item spike and Undying Rage at 6, your Riftmaker and 2-item window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Bloodlust was repeatedly labelled 'W Bloodlust' (whys[0], spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[1]). Bloodlust is his Q; W is Mocking Shout. Several dosFull/dontsFull bodies were copies of the trading blurb rather than the interaction, and no line carried the real Undying Rage or Bloodlust cooldowns.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Bloodlust (12s, heal, consumes Fury), W Mocking Shout (14s, 850 range, AD shred + slow on turned backs), E Spinning Slash (12/11/10/9/8s, 650 range), R Undying Rage (120/100/80s). Vladimir's Q Transfusion is 600 range; Hemoplague is a flat 120s.
audit.corrected: Real slot letters, real cooldowns, the range gap (600 vs 650) and the anti-heal timing written into dosFull and dontsFull.

audit.why: Anti-heal was already listed in itemization; the missing-interaction record wanted the timing stated, which now sits in dosFull[1].d.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Pool + out-scale it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable 5s, then 120s down at rank 1 — commit your burst after it expires.

edits.before: Transfusion Tryndamere on cooldown, E-charge behind the wave, and pool the one ability his kill plan needs.
edits.after: Bloodlust (Q) turns his Fury into healing every 12s — buy Oblivion Orb before your first extended trade, not after.

edits.before: Tryndamere wastes Undying Rage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Transfusion is 600 range, his Spinning Slash 650 — poke, then step back.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Hemoplague is 120s — spent into 5s of immunity it does nothing.

edits.before: Tryndamere's level-1 crit autos plus W Bloodlust sustain beat your poke outright.
edits.after: Tryndamere's level-1 crit autos plus Q Bloodlust sustain beat your poke outright.

edits.before: Tryndamere spins in with E Spinning Slash and stacks Fury for crit autos; your E-Q poke barely dents him because he heals with W Bloodlust, so play for farm and pool his commit.
edits.after: Tryndamere spins in with E Spinning Slash on a 12s cooldown and stacks Fury; your E-Q poke barely dents him because Q Bloodlust converts that Fury into healing, so buy anti-heal early.

edits.before: Tryndamere out-trades you from level 1 — his crit autos and W Bloodlust sustain beat your poke, and he only gets stronger as he stacks Fury. Do not try to win short trades; farm with Q Transfusion at max range and hold W for his gap-close. Every level from 1 through 6 the lane favours him, so the goal is to survive even, not to win. Ward for jungle ganks since he loves to E over walls.
edits.after: Tryndamere out-trades you from level 1 — his crit autos and Q Bloodlust sustain beat your poke, and he only gets stronger as he stacks Fury. Do not try to win short trades; farm with Transfusion at its full 600 range and hold Sanguine Pool for his gap-close. Every level from 1 through 6 the lane favours him, so the goal is to survive even, not to win. Ward for ganks — his E crosses walls.

edits.before: Use W Bloodlust to sustain through your poke
edits.after: Use Q Bloodlust to heal Fury back through your poke

notes: Bloodlust was mis-slotted as W in four places; W is Mocking Shout. Level chart realigned to the packet and to the already-audited mirror (Tryndamere rows 0-5, Vladimir at 2+ items), proposed as matched full/content pairs.
